user.title: Build a Label Master Control device
user.description: Pick the domain this device controls. This is fixed for the device's lifetime - a different domain means building a different device.

labels.title: Pick labels
labels.description: Every {target_domain} entity that carries ALL of these labels becomes a member of this device.

name.title: Name this device
name.description: Suggested from the domain and labels you picked - type your own if you'd rather.

abort.already_configured: A device for this domain and label combination already exists.

init.title: Label Master Control options
init.description: Change which labels this device requires. The domain can't be changed here - build a new device for that.
